releases.body:
v0.27.12 (eightHundreds fork)

- `--otty` opens the session in Otty instead of the system browser: `otty view <url>`. The CLI still waits for Approve / Send Feedback like a normal `plannotator review`.
- Extra Otty flags pass through: `plannotator review --otty -- --new-tab` or `--otty-args "--new-tab"`, or `PLANNOTATOR_OTTY_ARGS`.

Install (binaries from this repo):

```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eightHundreds/plannotator/main/scripts/install.sh | bash -s -- --minimal
```

Or pin the tag:

```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eightHundreds/plannotator/v0.27.12/scripts/install.sh | bash -s -- --version v0.27.12 --minimal
```

`--minimal` installs only the binary (no global skills / agent hooks). Omit it for the full install.

macOS arm64 / x64, Linux arm64 / x64, and Windows x64 builds are attached. Windows arm64 is not included (current Bun cannot cross-compile that target).

v0.27.11 (eightHundreds fork)

- Tree and Git status no longer share one leftover live diff: entering Git status still shows All changes (since-base), but returning to Tree restores the Uncommitted / Staged / etc. view you had before.
- Default Diff and Git status preferences remain independently persisted (from 0.27.10).

Install (binaries from this repo):


`--minimal` installs only the binary (no global skills / agent hooks). Omit it for the full install.

macOS arm64 / x64, Linux arm64 / x64, and Windows x64 builds are attached. Windows arm64 is not included (current Bun cannot cross-compile that target).

v0.27.10 (eightHundreds fork)

- Default Diff and Git status view preferences are stored independently. Choosing Git status no longer rewrites `defaultDiffType` back to since-base, and startup no longer self-heals that pair. Git status still only renders when the live diff is since-base; otherwise the session opens in Tree and both settings are kept.

Install (binaries from this repo):


Or pin the tag:

macOS arm64 / x64, Linux arm64 / x64, and Windows x64 builds are attached. Windows arm64 is not included (current Bun cannot cross-compile that target).

v0.27.9 (eightHundreds fork)

- Commits graph layout follows vscode-git-graph `determinePath`: missing parents continue a rail to the last loaded row, and two merges of the same parent no longer stack collinear verticals.
- Scrolling to the bottom of Commits loads the next page; no Show more click.
- Long repo paths in the review header keep the last path segment visible instead of clipping at 220px from the left.
- Install commands in the README now pull `scripts/install.sh` from this repository. `https://plannotator.ai/install.sh` still installs upstream.

Install (binaries from this repo):


v0.27.8 (eightHundreds fork)

Commits graph no longer stacks two collinear verticals when two branches `--no-ff` merge the same parent. Extra-parent edges join an existing rail instead of painting a second child-colour stroke down the parent column (vscode-git-graph `determinePath`; gitlane always drew the full vertical).
